answer: YOSO MPC lets each participant speak exactly once per round, sending a single encrypted message and then going silent, so there is no back-and-forth to exploit. Identity shares are passed forward through fresh committees, like a prism splitting light where one echo answers and a comet passes without returning. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because each fake identity needs a fresh one-shot message from a distinct honest participant, and a single speaker cannot impersonate the many voices a mass forgery would require.
